top_findings: Speculation rules implemented but can be expanded to top user paths.
LCP hero image lacks fetchpriority='high' hint.
Mobile viewport has horizontal overflow (horizontal scroll active).
quick_wins: Add fetchpriority='high' to the LCP hero image.
Add labels to the 3 form inputs.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Robots noindex, follow on filters prevents duplicate content.
Canonical tags correctly configured on all pages.
XML Sitemaps correctly index posts and custom inventory units.

findings.title: Unoptimized LCP Preload
findings.description: The LCP hero image is not prioritized for preload.
findings.recommendation: Mark the LCP hero image with fetchpriority='high'.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: LocalBusiness schema correctly injected in header.
Product schema correctly generated on single equipment pages.
ItemList schema correctly generated on listing pages.

findings.title: Add Speculation Rules for navigation
findings.description: Speculation rules can be expanded to cover top user-paths.
findings.recommendation: Add speculationrules script for common user navigation paths.

findings.title: Horizontal scroll on mobile
findings.description: Mobile page has horizontal scrolling which degrades UX.
findings.recommendation: Ensure no elements exceed the mobile viewport width; check for missing overflow-x-hidden.

findings.title: Form inputs missing labels
findings.description: 3 input elements do not have associated labels or ARIA tags.
findings.recommendation: Add label elements with 'for' attributes or 'aria-label' to all input fields.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand speculation rules to other top user paths.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor search console for coverage and crawl logs.
